scope: Independent bounded re-review of INGRESS-001 library null-ID loss fence; not production integration acceptance.

resolved_findings.assessment: Enabled-ledger begin authenticates first. Authenticated id=NULL sets sticky generation loss and returns UNTRACKED. Unauthorized id=NULL returns UNAUTHORIZED before any ledger write. Disabled ledger remains UNTRACKED. Existing and future rows cannot regain exactness or count certainty in the lost generation.
resolved_findings.regression: missing_id_contract begins with exact/count-known count=1, rejects unauthorized null output at UINT64_MAX without observable time/count/exactness mutation, then verifies authenticated null output revokes certainty for the existing row and survives repeated source completion and a different-key later row. Static inspection confirms serial/rows also remain untouched by unauthorized null output.
